```
PLAN "Deload Week"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary recovery:
    name "Active recovery and CNS restoration"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload Week" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body Deload":
        warmup:
          running 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 3x8
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 90 seconds
          lat_stretch 90 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 90 seconds

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Body Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 2m
          hip_circles 1m
          bodyweight_squat 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          leg_press 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 90 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 90 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 90 seconds

      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          leg_swings 1m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 2x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          cable_row 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 90 seconds
          tricep_stretch 90 seconds
          spinal_twist 90 seconds
```
